description: Convert MP3, OGG, M4A or any decodable audio to a lossless 16-bit WAV.

faqs.a: The file is decoded to raw samples in your browser and re-encoded as 16-bit PCM WAV.
Any audio format your browser can decode: MP3, OGG, M4A/AAC, WAV, FLAC and more.
A 16-bit PCM WAV at the source's sample rate and channel count.

howto: Drop an audio file into the tool.
Click Download WAV to save the converted file.
title: Audio to WAV Converter
